knowledge.text: The vision model often fails to locate the green box, even when it is visible in the environment.
Requesting a 0-degree turn may result in unintended movement, such as turning 3 degrees left when asked to turn 0 degrees.
The vision model failed to find targets in pictures #23, #24, and #25, even when targets were previously located.

skills.text: To pick up, align closely and ensure the banana is within 0.05 m of the beak tip before closing.
If the vision model fails to find a target, rely on the last known coordinates or visual confirmation.
When making fine adjustments, be aware that requested turn values may not match the executed turn.
